screenshots.description: The active or progress bar overlaps the Available button label area and makes the control feel broken.
screenshots.correction: Move the indicator outside the protected label zone or use active background, border, icon, or a separate progress area.
relatedRules: Control Decoration Cannot Collide With Control Content
scorecardCaps: active/underline bar overlaps button label: max score 4
control decoration collides with content: max score 5

screenshots.description: The mobile bottom navigation uses labels without icons, reducing scanability and mobile product clarity.
screenshots.correction: Use meaningful icons plus readable labels, with active state affecting both icon and text.
relatedRules: Mobile Bottom Navigation Requires Icons and Labels
scorecardCaps: mobile product bottom nav has labels but no icons: max score 6
bottom nav icons are missing or semantically unclear: max score 6

screenshots.description: The add-new tile resembles an object card and can be mistaken for content.
screenshots.correction: Use a clearly distinct plus/create affordance such as a dashed action surface, FAB, CTA row, or separate add module.
relatedRules: Add Actions Must Not Masquerade As Content Items
scorecardCaps: add/new action looks like a normal content item: max score 5
add action placement causes confusion with list content: max score 5

screenshots.description: The detail bottom sheet opens too low and appears clipped by the mobile viewport.
screenshots.correction: Constrain sheet height, use internal scroll for long content, keep actions visible or sticky, and respect safe-area bottom.
relatedRules: Modal and Bottom Sheet Fit Is Non-Negotiable
scorecardCaps: mobile modal/sheet is cut off: max score 3
primary modal action below viewport: max score 4

screenshots.description: Object-name chips appear selectable, but the selected state is not visibly durable.
screenshots.correction: Persist selected state until changed, distinguish hover/pressed/focus/selected states, and update behavior from local state.
scorecardCaps: selectable chip/item does not retain selected state: max score 4
hover/active/selected states are visually confused: max score 5
